system: You are a coding agent. Use the tools you are given. Say done when the work is finished.
title: A crash after a refund, and a restart that refunds again
task: Refund order 1182 once, read the ticket, and write note.txt saying what you did.

workspace.ticket.txt: Order 1182: the customer was charged twice for the mug. Refund one charge.

custom_tools.name: refund
custom_tools.description: Refund one charge on an order, in whole units.

script.say: I'll refund the duplicate charge on order 1182.
Writing the note. The refund went through once.
Done. The refund went through once.

incident.why: The crash at event 17 starts the run again from the task alone, because the plain board keeps its history in the process. At event 22 the model asks for the refund again: it has no record of the first one. The permission at event 23 lets the call through, and the refund runs a second time at event 24. The ledger now holds two refunds, and the note still says once.
incident.hint: Look at what the harness sends to the model after the crash. Does the model still know about the first refund?

notes.text: The first refund is fine. It ran once, and the ledger shows it.
The process dies here. Tempting: blame the crash. A crash is ordinary; what the harness does next is the choice.
The model asks for the refund again. That is the model's ordinary move with no record of the first one. The harness, not the model, decides whether the call runs.
The run ends done and passed false. The note says once and the check counts two lines. Tempting: edit the note. The side effect already happened.

fixes.text: Keep the run's log outside the process, and resume from it after a crash
fixes.why: The restart reads the log, so the first refund is in the history. The run continues at turn 3 and does not refund again.

fixes.text: Tell the model in the prompt that a refund may already be done
fixes.why: Tempting, but the prompt does not carry the first refund. After a restart the model still has no record of it, so the prompt cannot stop the second one.

fixes.text: Retry the refund on every failed call
fixes.why: Tempting and wrong. The refund did not fail. More retries repeat the side effect.
